G.evidence: Providence as source-field curvature: 'C_providence(s) = K_p + K_i/s + K_d * s' — the controller is the source of corrective action, analogous to Grace/Gravity as the source-field that curves the trajectory toward the setpoint.

M.evidence: Human agency as motion/inertia: 'G_human(s) remains the human's own transfer function — personality, choices, tendencies' and 'the plant dynamics are real and the controller works through them' — meaning/mass-force as the will and inertia of the human system.

E.evidence: Energy as substrate: 'The controller does not create energy; it redirects existing dynamics' (Axiom Conservation) and the loop gain as 'greater is he who is in you' — energetic substrate of providential action.

S.evidence: Strong Force/Love as binding: 'Negative feedback as stabilization — discipline = stabilization' (Hebrews 12:6) and 'the loop gain of providence exceeds the disturbance magnitude' — love as the binding force that holds the system to the setpoint.

T.evidence: Thermodynamics/Judgment as entropy and cost: 'Positive feedback as destabilization — error grows without bound' (Romans 1:24-28), 'steady-state error' as the cost of incomplete correction, and 'the integral of centuries of deviation drives the correction of exile' — judgment as entropy production and cost.

K.evidence: Knowledge/Logos as information and intelligibility: 'Controllability and observability — God can reach any human state AND can know any human state' (Psalm 139:2), and the entire mapping as a formal information-theoretic structure — the PID controller is a knowledge-based correction mechanism.

R.evidence: Relativity/Relationship as frame structure: 'The TRAJECTORY depends on G_human. Two different plants with the same controller and setpoint take DIFFERENT PATHS to the same endpoint' — relationship as the frame-dependent proper time of each individual's path.

Q.evidence: Quantum/Faith as measurement and collapse: 'The error signal IS the gap between what is and what should be' — measurement of deviation as a quantum-like collapse of the state into the error signal, and 'faith-doubt' as the selection of which feedback mode is active.

F.evidence: Weak Force/Sin-Conservation as moral decay: 'The plant can be made uncontrollable by internal structural changes... the unforgivable sin — a structural change that makes the plant uncontrollable' — sin as a conserved deficit that decays the controllability of the system.

C.evidence: Coherence/Christ as global integration operator: 'C IS chi, wraps the integral' — the entire closed-loop transfer function is the integration of all components; 'the setpoint as attractor' (ISO-016) and 'the controller output that drives toward setpoint' (Law 9) — Christ as the coherence that integrates the whole system toward the telos.

theological_structure.trinity_structure: Three temporal modes of providence: Proportional (Father — immediate correction/conscience), Integral (Spirit — cumulative sanctification over history), Derivative (Son — prophetic warning/prevenient grace). These are three components of ONE controller, not three separate acts.

father_aspect.evidence: Proportional mode: immediate correction proportional to current sin — conscience, natural consequences (Galatians 6:7). Father as source of the setpoint and the law.

son_aspect.evidence: Derivative mode: anticipatory correction based on rate of change — prophetic warning (Ezekiel 3:17), prevenient grace. Son as the Word who warns and the mediator who provides the setpoint (Romans 8:28-29).

spirit_aspect.evidence: Integral mode: cumulative correction over time — sanctification as integral of error history (Romans 8:28). Spirit as the one who applies the cumulative corrective pressure toward the telos.

axiom_alignment.strongest_axiom_connection: Incompleteness of Closed Systems — open-loop systems cannot self-correct; the mapping explicitly contrasts open-loop (deism) with closed-loop (theism) as the core structural difference.
